title: Chapter 531
paragraphs: Chapter 531
Episode 144. For a Friend (9)
Upon seeing his friend who had come running in a month, the blood trickling from Dante's eyes lightened a bit.
For a while, Dante couldn't take his eyes off Jin, as if time had stopped.
The hatred and madness, the rapid changes in his inner self, stained and destroyed by blood, seemed to be quickly subsiding.
Realizing that there's someone to rely on when cornered was like that.
Dante had hoped that Jin would not come to this quagmire, but that was because he thought it was right as a friend.
In fact, more than anyone, Dante wanted Jin to fight with him.
If it were the same situation, he would have risked everything to help Jin.
"…Jin, you came."
"You speak as if it's a surprise. Yes, it's me."
Thud!
Dante knelt down on one knee and collapsed on the floor.
As soon as he confirmed Jin's presence, the feeling of exhaustion, which had been obscured by anger, started to shake his whole body.
Even standing still, his joints were shaking, and dark blood flowed from every hole in his face.
For Jin, it was unbelievable that Dante had managed to stand and even fight with that body.
"Were you trying to die, Dante?"
"Shamefully, yes."
"Do you feel a little like living now?"
Dante nodded his head.
"I was worried about having to knock you out again, but I'm glad."
"If I get hit by you in my current state, I could die."
"Anyway, you held out well. Rest and come back when you can fight again."
Jin chuckled and helped Dante onto Shuri's back. Dante, who climbed onto Shuri, alternated his gaze between Jin and the battlefield, then nodded his head.
He realized, as his friend said, there has to be a next time.
"…Thank you."
At Jin's signal, Shuri kicked the ground and headed towards the Imperial Palace.
The enemies could not dare to block its path, due to the sharp magical rays shooting from its eyes and the swinging of its front legs.
Inside the Imperial Palace, the highest-ranking healers of the kingdom, brought by Jin, were waiting.
"…This is the first time I've seen you look so serious, Sir Jin Runkandel."
"First, I want to thank you for waiting. Dragon Knight Commander, Sir Zoncina Ferrell."
It was not about not interrupting his conversation with Dante just now.
It wasn't about not interrupting his conversation with Dante just now.
Jin thought that Zoncina had intentionally not killed Dante and waited for him.
Judging by Dante's condition, Zoncina could have finished him off anytime within the five-way fight.
Even though there was a secret technique that put his life on the line, the moment he initiated it, Dante's death was practically certain.
In that case, Zoncina planned to somehow knock Dante unconscious before the technique was initiated, and send him back to the Imperial Palace.
In other words, Zoncina had no intention of killing Dante, and Jin was curious about why.

"It's bitter. I never thought a man like you would abandon your faith and participate in the emperor's tyranny. And trying to save Dante in the midst of all this, what's your motive? Guilt? Hypocrisy? I hope it's not such lukewarm reasons."
"I am a knight of the empire."
It was a statement with a lot of implications.
As a knight of the empire, Zoncina had simply chosen the path that could save the most people. As a knight of the empire, there was no better choice.
The reason for trying to save Dante was the hope that the flame named Hyran wouldn't be completely extinguished.
Since this war could never be won by Hyran as long as Jifl was involved, he hoped that someday that flame would restore the empire.
Dante Hyran could do it, he could transcend hatred and vengeance and ultimately choose the shining cause. Zoncina was confident of that.
Jin easily read the underlying meaning.
"It seems like Jifl threatened to destroy the empire if they don't hand over the White Stone."
Zoncina didn't answer.
For whatever reason, he stood as an enemy of the Imperial Palace, and while it was the right thing considering the people, it was a choice that could never be called honorable.
"Your choice was wrong. Do you have any thoughts of correcting that choice now? Dante and I will never give up on Hyran."
"Even if you don't know, it seems unlikely that all of Runkandel will assist the Imperial Palace."
"If the White Stone is valuable enough for all of Jifl to mobilize, the Garden of the Sword will not stay idle either."

"Even if that's the case, I don't want a future where the empire becomes a battlefield for Runkandel and Jifl. The people are not as familiar with death as the warriors. Protecting their lives is the only duty of an imperial knight."
"I respect that."
A person's life reflects everything about them.
As far as Jin knew, the character known as Zoncina Ferrell was never one to make misguided choices for personal desires or survival.
In any case, there is always a price to pay for choices.
Fzzz!
Sigmund was dyed blue with lightning.
Zoncina's great sword also emitted a stronger light than before and rang a resonant sound.
Both of them charged towards each other simultaneously.
As soon as the first clash happened, the ground shook and a shock wave spread.
The Emperor's soldiers nearby hastily raised their shields, but there weren't many who could withstand the shockwaves mixed with the lightning.
It merely seemed as if lights were flashing everywhere.
With each passing second, the flash that stained the surroundings was all the afterimage created by the movement of their swords.
Only when their swords clashed against each other in a power struggle could those who had not reached the state of enlightenment confirm the two men's battle.
'Is he truly the imperial swordsman?'
There was no opening in sight.
John Cena was also mixing his sword with Jin's and had the same thought.
'I've heard about the prowess of the 12th Knight... Is this the extent of it? Dominance is impossible. The fight will be long.'
However, Jin did not intend to prolong the fight.

John Cena was undoubtedly a strong character, but he was not the crux of this war. If he struggled with him and used too much power, he wouldn't be able to handle the reinforcements from Zepplin that would soon arrive.
Even if Jin's forces were formidable, it was absolutely impossible to defeat Zepplin's main force with just that. Unless it was not about sending the strength of 2 or 3 armies.
'If the Emperor had only received support from 2 or 3 armies, he wouldn't have started the war with so much confidence.'
In order to block the incoming enemies and allow Dante and the knights of Hyran to escape, he had to conserve his energy.
Zwoong-!
Jin regained his posture as he was pushed back.
John Cena closed the distance without hesitation, and at the same time, Sigmund stretched forward. At an angle and speed that John Cena could not understand.
It was the 5th secret technique of Runkandel, named after the King of Kings, the Lightspeed Thrust.
The thrust seemed to erase John Cena's face, but Jin had to confirm that he was hesitating and regaining his distance.
It was not the realm of talent or sense that allowed John Cena to avoid the Lightspeed Thrust.
Experience.
Decades of experience fighting numerous strong opponents made him unconsciously twist his head.
However, he couldn't completely avoid it.

The sword's energy of the Lightspeed Thrust took a part of his cheek and his right ear. A sharp tinnitus accompanied the burning sensation, and John Cena almost turned his head back where the sword energy had passed.
'What on earth was that? A thrust at such speed?'
It was definitely not a fatal wound.
However, the fact that his body stiffened for a moment due to shock was far more critical than the wound he had just received.
Jin did not miss that opportunity and gritted his teeth, burning his heart with fervor. It was to unleash another Lightspeed Thrust.
Like all decisive techniques and secret moves, the Lightspeed Thrust was particularly dangerous when its existence was completely unknown.
Once they realized that a thrust at an absurd speed could pop out of the blue at any time, those who had reached enlightenment could somewhat respond to the Lightspeed Thrust.
John Cena sidestepped and swung his sword.
No, he tried to strike. He could have completed the move if there hadn't been an unexpected burst of energy starting from the point of the light-speed strike.
Crackling!
He had recognized the light-speed strike, but he hadn't anticipated the uniqueness of the blast.
The fact that Jin's light-speed strike caused an aftermath was already confirmed in the rear battlefield, but no one was left there who could report this fact to Jonshina. They all died or fled.
The subsequent second light-speed strike pierced Jonshina's shoulder.
Suddenly, Jin was holding another sword, Bradamante, not Siegmund. Siegmund was thrown and stuck between the two during the second light-speed strike.

The lightning pouring out without a break was no different than being fixed to the ground. Siegmund spat out lightning until the ground was completely gone, and Jonshina let out a roar, detonating his energy.
A powerful light, bright enough to illuminate the dark battlefield, clashed, and a streak of black energy mixed in between.
Two styles of the spirit sword, Scissors.
Jonshina perfectly blocked one black blade even in his broken stance, but didn't recognize the spirit energy charging from the other side.
Thanks to the exploding aura and his strong physique, he avoided total collapse.
However, the blade that pierced his ribs was already halfway into his chest.
Cutting down a warrior he admired as a child was a bitter thing.
Jonshina could no longer counterattack.
The match was decided.
"Please… protect… Hyran."
He sided with the emperor for the safety of the imperial people.
Jonshina, facing death, was pleading not for the people, but for Hyran.
What he sincerely wanted in his heart, rather than as an imperial knight, was for Hyran to survive.

Jin didn't find his last words cowardly. Whether it was out of respect, or because he could empathize with his feelings for Hyran rather than for his people, his family, or the empire, he didn't know.
Far behind Jonshina, a group of dragons and flying ships were approaching towards Sword Emperor City. It was Ziep's army.
Seeing this, Jin reassured Jonshina.
"Don't worry and close your eyes, Sir Jonshina. My Runcandel will become stronger than Ziep."
The moment Jonshina took his last breath.
On the opposite side of Ziep's reinforcements, the appearance of dragons was also spotted from the rear of Sword Emperor City.
Black Dragon and Silver Dragon.
And they were Hyran's dragon knights.
Murakan and Quicantel rescued the dragon knights with Hyran's five sword saints.
